description: Draft answers to up to 50 comments in one call (from comments_to_answer): a public reply, on Instagram a DM too, or saved_reply_id to send a saved reply as written. Each is kept or skipped on its own, with the reason. Drafts wait at the top of Inbox, marked Drafted by your assistant, for one tap (Send all sends them together). send: true sends them without a tap where the network allows it (not YouTube, TikTok or Mastodon: those always wait), only when the person allowed it for this connection; otherwise the call is refused and you ask them. Even then, an answer to a comment with a risk waits for a tap, and past the account's daily cap answers go later (reason says so). Keep the brand's voice and answer the question; a DM says it's automated and that STOP stops them.

answers.description: Up to 50 answers, each {comment_id, account_id, reply or saved_reply_id, dm?}, taken from comments_to_answer

dm.description: Instagram only, where dm_ok: a private reply (DM)

reply.description: Public reply; {name} becomes the commenter's username. Within the comment's reply_max

saved_reply_id.description: A saved reply's id (best_saved.id): its text becomes the public reply, unless reply is given

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

send.description: true: send without a tap where allowed. Needs the person's say-so for this connection

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
